title: Trivy documentation (paraphrase)
text: Trivy scans container images for known vulnerabilities and is commonly run in CI after the image is built and before it is pushed or deployed. The exit-code and severity options make the pipeline fail on findings, and --ignore-unfixed skips vulnerabilities that have no fix available yet.
